report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with sub-100ms durations except one 344ms outlier; gateway p95 for /v1/checkout is 437ms with zero 502s. Traces show healthy downstream spans (inventory, payment, postgres, redis) and memory retention well under limits. No current evidence establishes a bounded root cause; operator latency hypothesis is contradicted by healthy telemetry.
